Name: Poetic Harvey Expansion Dialogue
Author: besourius
Description:
[center][size=3][font=Arial][/font][/size][/center][center][/center][center]﻿﻿﻿[size=3][font=Arial]﻿This mod transforms [b]Harvey[/b] into a deeper, more emotionally complex and poetic character, through over [b]600+ custom dialogue lines[/b] that evolve throughout the seasons, weather, festivals, and relationship stages[/font][font=Arial].[/font][font=Arial]Through new dialogues, emotional nuance, and interactions with other villagers, Harvey becomes an immersive romantic interest: gentle, nerdy, passionate, occasionally awkward, sometimes jealous, and always attentive in his own quiet way. ﻿[/font][/size]★[font=Arial]

﻿[/font]──── ୨୧ ────[font=Arial]

[size=4]﻿[/size][/font][size=4][font=Arial][b]Features[/b][/font] ﻿[/size][size=3]
[b]Seasonal daily dialogues[/b]: Custom lines for every day of each season, with variation depending on weather, relationship level, and mood.

[b]Romantic progression[/b]: As your bond grows, Harvey's speech becomes more affectionate, poetic, and vulnerable.

[b]Festival-specific lines[/b]: Dozens of dialogues tied to festival days, both before and after the events (Luau, Flower Dance, Spirit’s Eve, and more).

[b]Other villagers comment[/b]: Characters like Shane, Leah, Penny, Alex, Sebastian, Caroline, and others now have [b]unique reactions[/b] and comments about Harvey and your relationship.

[b]Post-marriage content[/b]: Immersive married life with rainy day talks, nerdy airplane rambles, insecurities about age, dreams, and even flirtatious jealousy.

[b]Character actions & flavor[/b]: Uses commands to show [b]Harvey's gestures[/b], sketches, habits, and reactions for added immersion.

[b]Expanded personality[/b][/size][size=3]: Harvey is no longer just a doctor, he’s an artist, a nervous romantic, an aviation nerd, and someone who truly feels alive around you.
[/size]
﻿──── ୨୧ ────

[size=4][font=Arial]﻿[/font][font=Arial][b]How to Install ﻿﻿[/b][/font]₍^. .^₎⟆[/size][font=Arial][size=3]
Requirements:
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url][/size][/font]﻿[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/size][font=Arial][size=3]
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=4]Installation Steps:[/size]
[/font]Install SMAPI
Install Content Patcher.
Download this mod.
Unzip the mod folder.
Place the unzipped folder into your mods directory
[font=Arial][size=3]Launch the game and enjoy a whole new side of Harvey.[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=3]

I plan to update this mod with more events and more dialogue soon! ﻿[/size][/font]₍ᐢ. .ᐢ₎[/center]
[center]﻿──── ୨୧ ────

[/size]These are not required, but if you'd like to replicate the visuals in my preview images, here’s what I used:[size=3]

[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown – Flowery Interface[/url][/size][/center][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]
[/url][/size]﻿[size=3]
[/size][center]﻿──── ୨୧ ────[/center]
[center][/center][center][size=3]This mod was created primarily as a [b]personal project[/b], born out of love for Harvey!
But if you connect with it too, [b]I hope it brings you as much comfort and joy as it brought me while creating it. ﻿[/b]ㅤ♡
[size=3] ﻿[/size]𐔌  . ୧ [i]To anyone who finds meaning in these little moments with Harvey... have fun, and take care.[/i] ﻿![/size][/center]
